visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a person's hands holding a light pink and blue plastic package for a 'Soap Bubble Bath' product. The hands have shimmering pink glitter nail polish, and the background is a simple white tiled wall. (2) A brief cut inserts a popular meme of an orange-haired cartoon man waving a stack of cash. The video then shows the back of the packaging, highlighting the detailed instructional stickers in Chinese and Japanese characters. (3) The hands proceed to tear open the plastic wrapper, revealing a solid pink heart-shaped bubble wand mounted on a light-colored wooden popsicle stick. The person turns the wand around to show its thickness and the heart-shaped aperture in the center. (4) The scene shifts to a white bathtub filled with clear water. The hand dips the pink heart wand into the water and lifts it up, showing a thin soapy film across the hole. The person then blows through the hole, creating large, floating bubbles. (5) A shower head is brought into the frame and sprays a steady stream of water directly onto the pink wand held above the bath. Thick white foam quickly generates and spreads across the water's surface, filling the tub. (6) A first-person view shows the creator's feet submerged in a dense layer of white bubbles in the tub while they blow more bubbles with the wand. Finally, two different versions of the product (pink heart and yellow star) are displayed side-by-side, followed by a thumbs-up gesture in the foamy water.

It demonstrates the product's dual functionality as both a bubble wand and a soap source for a bubble bath, highlighting its fun and nostalgic appeal for adults and children alike.
